Official Category Feeds

How to Subscribe

  1. Apple Calendar (iOS / Mac) & Outlook: Click the Subscribe (webcal) button for direct 1-click subscription.
  2. Google Calendar: Click Copy Link, open Google Calendar, go to Other calendars (+) > From URL, and paste the link.
  3. Automatic Updates: When dates change on the university portal, your calendar syncs automatically.
